gate: 20C.4 Gate B — single-source service reference: shadow computation
semantics: Shadow computation of the proposed shared service reference against the CURRENT corridor placement; diagnostic only. Not a golden target.

definitions.oldLateral: footwall_edge(z)·n + footwallStandoff (the rule-170 corridor lateral coordinate along the family lateral direction n)
definitions.anchorTraceSupport: max over the WORLD-policy offset-trace points (anchor stand-off, token WORLD) inside the family footprint window of p·n
definitions.delta: max(0, anchorTraceSupport + RAMP_CORRIDOR_MARGIN_WIDTHS·width − oldLateral): the outward move that restores 6 widths between the corridor and every anchor-backbone point it passes; never negative (the corridor is never pulled inward)
definitions.footprintWindow: SPIRAL: |u − u_axis| ≤ R + margin; SWITCHBACK: |proj_leg − leg centre| ≤ leg/2 + margin (k = 1 leg, conservative); LONGITUDINAL: whole trace. NOTE: the windowed shadow centres the window on the track centroid, which is NOT where an oblique (p ± 20) leg actually lies — the direct check below centres it on the delivered corridor and is the authoritative number
definitions.directCheck: per level: the DELIVERED ramp's ore-facing extreme lateral within ±3 m of the RL versus the formula, the stage-4 anchor lateral, and the windowed trace support centred on the delivered corridor position

tabularShadow.contract: TABULAR keeps the analytic corridor path (delta ≡ 0): both the rule-43 anchor line and the track edge derive from the analytic footwall plane
tabularShadow.numerical: the track-fit residual on TABULAR-42 is 0.02–0.39 m per level; the measured anchor→track-edge offset is 21.3 m against the 20 m stand-off (grid-fit residual of the analytic edge), so a numerically re-derived delta would be ≤ 1.3 m — the contract does not apply it; geometry is unchanged bit-for-bit
